data.description: 名流茶会，她穿着连衣裙执杯的姿势无可挑剔，与长辈应对得体；镜头捕捉到她借转头的瞬间偷偷松了半口气，又立刻恢复完美表情管理。
data.promptProse: Yuki stands at the tea gathering holding her cup neatly and turns aside with a small, relieved exhale. Behind her in soft window light, an older woman with gray hair pinned up sits at the table beside an older man in a dark formal jacket. Their seated profiles hold the background while the foreground stays with Yuki and her cup.
data.title: 周防有希 · 茶会上的淑女满分
data.animaCaption: Yuki stands with her cup and briefly turns her face away. The guests behind her stay seated: an older woman with gray pinned hair and an older man in a dark formal jacket.
